Home.heroSubtitle: We run twelve focused divisions—from software and digital marketing to healthcare support, construction, trade, and logistics—so you can work with one group that understands operational detail, not just slide decks.
Home.globalReachDesc: Registered operations and commercial teams in Telangana, India, and Ocala, Florida, with digital products and trading relationships that extend further where our divisions serve clients.
Home.sustainableGrowthDesc: We invest in processes, training, and technology that hold up under audit and scale—so growth does not come at the cost of compliance, safety, or client trust.
Home.trustedPartnerDesc: Each division has named responsibilities, documented standards, and escalation paths. Partners receive straightforward communication—not generic promises.
Home.description: Doddapaneni Group is the parent company for a portfolio of operating divisions and brands. Technology and marketing teams build web and automation solutions; other divisions support healthcare-related supply and billing workflows, construction and property work, import–export desks, manufacturing and wholesale, warehousing and freight, consumer platforms, media, staffing, education, and food-sector programs. We publish sector articles on this site so visitors can see how each unit approaches its market. If you need a formal introduction, regulatory filing reference, or vendor onboarding pack, use the Contact page and we will route you to the right division.
Home.drivingExcellence: DealsMedi (USA health products), Dlsin (multivendor commerce), and Janatha Mirror (digital news) are three public-facing brands you can explore in depth via the links below.
Home.diverseSolutions: For a sector-by-sector list of capabilities, explore Our Services in the header or the Services page.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce Marketplace
ecommerce.description: We design, develop, and manage scalable e-commerce ecosystems that support modern business models. Our solutions include online retail platforms, multi-vendor marketplaces, global trading portals, and dropshipping and wholesale systems optimized for performance and growth.

software.title: Information Technology & AI Development
software.description: We provide end-to-end digital solutions including web and mobile application development, AI-powered automation, chatbots, cloud services, SaaS platforms, and IT consulting. Our technology solutions are designed to enhance efficiency, security, and scalability.

digitalMarketing.title: Digital Marketing
digitalMarketing.description: Our digital marketing services focus on building brand visibility and driving measurable growth. We offer SEO and keyword optimization, social media management, branding and advertising campaigns, and lead generation through performance-driven strategies.

healthcare.title: Healthcare & Medical
healthcare.description: We support healthcare providers with medical equipment trading and comprehensive backend services. Our offerings include CPAP and BiPAP devices, medical consumables, wholesale distribution, medical billing and coding, insurance claims processing, EHR/EMR integration, telehealth billing, and complete Revenue Cycle Management solutions.

construction.title: Construction & Real Estate
construction.description: We deliver construction and real estate solutions covering building construction, architectural design, real estate development, and property consulting, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely execution.

importExport.title: Import & Export
importExport.description: We facilitate international trade through global sourcing, wholesale exports, international trading, and cross-border logistics, enabling smooth and compliant global operations.

food.title: Food & Baverages
food.description: Our food processing and beverage division focuses on packaged food production, beverage manufacturing, and efficient food supply chain distribution.

education.title: Education & Skill Development
education.description: We provide training programs, vocational courses, e-learning platforms, and certification programs designed to build industry-relevant skills and career-ready professionals.

logistics.title: Logistics & Warehousing
logistics.description: We offer end-to-end logistics solutions including freight and cargo handling, storage and warehousing, supply chain management, and last-mile delivery services.

media.title: Media, News & Entertainment
media.description: Our media division manages digital news portals, media production, video and content creation, and advertising network management.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing & Trading
manufacturing.description: We operate industrial manufacturing units, custom production facilities, and bulk wholesale trading operations to support diverse industry needs.

staffing.title: Human Resources & Consultancy
staffing.description: We assist organizations with recruitment and staffing, HR consulting, and workforce management, helping businesses build efficient and high-performing teams.

About.metaTitle: About Doddapaneni Group | Vision, Mission & Business Divisions
About.metaDescription: Learn about Doddapaneni Group: our corporate vision, mission, and business divisions spanning Information Technology & AI Development, Digital Marketing, Healthcare & Medical, Construction & Real Estate, E-commerce Marketplace, Media, News & Entertainment, Human Resources & Consultancy, Food & Baverages, Manufacturing & Trading, Logistics & Warehousing, Education & Skill Development, and Import & Export.
About.metaKeywords: Doddapaneni Group, diversified conglomerate, corporate vision, business divisions, technology, healthcare, construction, digital marketing, import export, corporate profile
About.metaOgDescription: A corporate portfolio across twelve industries—built on integrity, innovation, and long-term value for partners and communities.
About.headerSubtitle: A diversified business group delivering disciplined execution, responsible growth, and enduring relationships across twelve sector verticals.
About.introImageAlt: Corporate leadership and strategy discussion representing Doddapaneni Group
About.introText: Doddapaneni Group is a diversified enterprise organized for scale, governance, and cross-industry collaboration. We combine sector depth with group-level standards in compliance, quality, and client service—so every division can move quickly without compromising the trust placed in our name. Our work spans technology and digital services, healthcare and medical ecosystems, construction and real estate, global trade, industrial operations, logistics, consumer-facing platforms, media, talent services, education, and food and beverage value chains. We partner with clients, institutions, and operators who expect clarity of scope, measurable outcomes, and alignment with long-term economic and social impact.
About.visionText: To be a globally respected business group known for ethical leadership, operational excellence, and the ability to mobilize capabilities across industries—so clients and communities benefit from solutions that are innovative, reliable, and built to last.
About.missionText: To deliver high-quality, scalable offerings in each division; to invest in people, processes, and technology that raise the bar for service; to honor our commitments to partners, regulators, and society; and to grow sustainably while strengthening the companies and markets we serve.
About.companiesSubtitle: A unified ecosystem of specialized businesses.
About.divisionsSubtitle: A single group structure with dedicated sector leadership and shared standards of governance.
About.divisionsLead: Each division contributes distinct expertise while aligning to group principles: clear accountability, disciplined risk management, and relentless focus on outcomes for stakeholders.
About.divisionsCta: Explore group services and capabilities across sectors.
About.valuesSubtitle: Non-negotiable principles that guide decisions at every level of the organization.

PrivacyPolicy.introduction: Doddapaneni Group (“we”, “us”, “our”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains—in plain terms—what information we collect on this corporate website, how we use it, how cookies and similar technologies function here, how partners such as Google may process data when we show ads, and what choices you retain. It is written for visitors, clients, and partners who browse doddapanenigroup.net (and related company sites we operate). By continuing to use the site, you acknowledge this Policy where applicable law allows.
PrivacyPolicy.informationWeCollectLead: We collect information in the following ways:
PrivacyPolicy.informationWeCollectDesc: We may collect information that you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you choose to provide when you contact us or subscribe to our newsletter.
PrivacyPolicy.informationWeCollectYouProvideDesc: When you contact us, subscribe to updates, submit forms, or otherwise communicate with us, you may provide identifiers such as your name, email address, phone number, organisation, and the content of your message. We use this to respond, provide services, and meet our contractual and legal obligations.
PrivacyPolicy.informationWeCollectAutoDesc: When you visit our website, our servers and partners may automatically receive technical data such as IP address, approximate location derived from IP, browser type and version, device type, operating system, referring URLs, pages viewed, and timestamps. This helps us secure the site, measure performance, debug issues, and understand aggregate usage.
PrivacyPolicy.informationWeCollectSensitiveDesc: We do not intentionally solicit special categories of personal data (such as health data) through general website forms. Please do not submit sensitive information unless a specific form clearly requires it for a stated purpose.
PrivacyPolicy.cookiesDesc: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.
PrivacyPolicy.cookiesLead: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We and our partners may also use pixels, local storage, and similar technologies for the purposes described below.
PrivacyPolicy.cookiesEssentialDesc: Some cookies are necessary for security, load balancing, language or locale preferences, and core site functionality. These may be set without consent where permitted by law.
PrivacyPolicy.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: We may use analytics tools to collect aggregated statistics about traffic and navigation. Where required, we rely on your consent or legitimate interests to improve our content and user experience.
PrivacyPolicy.cookiesAdvertisingDesc: We may use third-party advertising services (such as Google AdSense) that set cookies or use advertising identifiers to show ads on our site, measure ad delivery, and—depending on your settings and applicable law—personalise ads based on your visits to this and other websites. These partners may combine data from our site with data from other sites and apps.
PrivacyPolicy.cookiesChoicesDesc: You can control cookies through your browser settings (including blocking or deleting cookies). You can also visit Google’s Ads Settings and the NAI / DAA opt-out resources to learn more about personalised ads and limit certain uses. Note that disabling cookies may affect site features.
PrivacyPolicy.thirdPartyDesc: We may use third-party services that collect, monitor, and analyze information to help us improve our website and services.
PrivacyPolicy.thirdPartyLead: We may integrate services provided by third parties. These providers process data under their own policies and may act as independent controllers or processors.
PrivacyPolicy.thirdPartyGoogleDesc: Our site may use Google services such as Google AdSense (advertising) and, where implemented, Google Analytics or related measurement tools. Google’s use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on users’ visits to our site and/or other sites on the Internet. You can review how Google uses information from sites that use its services at the link below, and read Google’s Privacy Policy for more detail.
PrivacyPolicy.thirdPartyOtherDesc: We may use additional providers for hosting, email delivery, content delivery, security, or embedded media. Each processes only the data needed to perform its role.
PrivacyPolicy.thirdPartyLiabilityDesc: Our website may link to external sites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices. Please read the policies of any site you visit.
PrivacyPolicy.adsenseNoticeDesc: Where we display third-party ads, those ads may be personalised using cookies or mobile identifiers, subject to your choices and applicable regulations. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user’s prior visits to our website or other websites. Users may opt out of personalised advertising by adjusting ad settings in their Google Account or using industry opt-out tools where available. EU / UK / similar users may see consent mechanisms as required by law.
PrivacyPolicy.howWeUseDesc: We use personal and technical information to: operate and improve our website; respond to enquiries and provide customer support; send administrative or service-related messages; analyse traffic and performance; deliver and measure advertising where enabled; detect fraud, abuse, and security incidents; comply with law, regulation, or legal process; and enforce our terms.
PrivacyPolicy.dataProtectionDesc: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures designed to protect personal information. No method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure. We retain information only as long as necessary for the purposes above, unless a longer period is required by law or legitimate business needs (such as resolving disputes).
PrivacyPolicy.yourRightsDesc: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, rectify, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing, or to data portability. You may also withdraw consent where processing is consent-based. To exercise rights or ask questions about this Policy, contact us via the details on our Contact page (for example doddapanenigroup [at] yahoo.com). We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling certain requests.
PrivacyPolicy.childrenDesc: Our website is not directed at children under 16 (or the age required in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected such data, please contact us so we can delete it.
PrivacyPolicy.internationalDesc: We may process data in India, the United States, the European Economic Area, or other regions where we or our providers operate. We use appropriate safeguards as required by applicable law when data crosses borders.
PrivacyPolicy.changesDesc: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect legal, technical, or business changes. The “Last updated” date at the top will be revised when we post a new version. FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Practical answers about how the group is organised, where we are based, and how to reach the right team.
FAQ.contactSupportDesc: Use the Contact page for partnership enquiries, media requests, or vendor onboarding. We route messages to the correct division.

q1.question: What does Doddapaneni Group actually do?
q1.answer: We are a parent organisation for twelve operating divisions. In practice that means software and IT work, digital marketing, healthcare-related products and back-office support, construction and real-estate activity, e-commerce platforms, media, staffing, food and manufacturing, logistics, education programmes, and import–export. The Services page summarises each area; division hubs and News publish more detail.

q2.question: Where is Doddapaneni Group located?
q2.answer: Corporate addresses on file include India: Plot No 22,23,41,42 & 43, Sri Krishna Avenue, Venkataramana Colony, Gokul Plots, Vasanth Nagar, Ranga Reddy District, Telangana 500085; and USA: 5052 SW 40th PL, Ocala, Florida 34474. Individual brands may publish their own support channels.

q3.question: How can I contact Doddapaneni Group?
q3.answer: Email doddapanenigroup@yahoo.com, call +91 814 224 6666 (India) or +1 (352) 230-8586 (USA) during published office hours, or submit the enquiry form on the Contact page with your organisation name so we can reply accurately.

q4.question: Do you work with clients outside India and the USA?
q4.answer: Yes, depending on the division. E-commerce, software, trade, and media properties may serve users or buyers in additional countries subject to law, payment rules, and product restrictions. State your country in any enquiry so compliance can be checked before work begins.

q5.question: Which brands are part of the group?
q5.answer: This site highlights DealsMedi (USA-focused medical and health product sales), Dlsin (multivendor online commerce), and Janatha Mirror (digital news and related media). Other divisions operate under their own trade styles; the About page lists all twelve verticals.

q6.question: Is there a newsletter?
q6.answer: If a subscription field appears in the site footer, you may join the mailing list there. We use email addresses only for the purpose stated beside the form; see the Privacy Policy for how we handle subscriber data.
